text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, March 17 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel awaiting cargo, 3 due by 9/3. Approx. 1 day delay expected.
Dalrymple Bay - Maintenance shutdown scheduled for 0700 hrs 8/4 until 2359 hrs 11/4. No loading/Berthing. Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 11 due by 22/3. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected.
Hay point - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 11 due by 27/3. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 20 due by 11/4. Approx 2-3 days delay expected.
Barney Point - Berth vacant. 3 Vessels due by 7/4. No delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant. 5 Vessels due by 20/4. No delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 10 waiting. 13 Vessels due by 1/4. Approx. 8-9 days delay expected.
Channel (Dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 5 waiting. 21 Vessels due by 31/3. Approx. 6-7 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - Berth vacant. 21 Vessels due by 6/6. No delays.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to current shortage of Mt. Newman and Yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some berthing/loading delays or be forced to berth out of turn. A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored. 4 Vessels due by 23/3. B berth - 1 Vessel berthing, 3 anchored. 4 vessels due by 23/3, 10 due by 29/3, no eta received.

Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - Due to current shortage of fines and maintenance difficulties, vessels may experience some delays in berthing/loading. One vessel loading, 2 anchored. 1 Vessel due by 18/3, 3 others due by 14/4, no eta received.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 6 anchored.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored.
Dampier line-up - 21 Vessels due by 6/4 of which 4 for East Intercourse island, 17 for Parker Point.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 12 due by 8/4.
March 19 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - no vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat. 2 Vessels due by 4/4, both to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Three vessels waiting to load wheat.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading wheat, 1 loading barley. 2 Vessels waiting to load wheat, 2 due by 8/4, both to load wheat.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting of which 1 to load canola, 1 peas. 2 Vessels due by 24/3 of which 1 to load wheat, 1 barley.

Portland - One vessel loading peas, 1 loading beans, 3 waiting to load of which 2 wheat, 1 peas. 9 Vessels due by 19/4 of which 6 to load wheat, 1 barley, 1 peas, 1 canola. Vicgrain terminal closed 24/3 for picnic day.

SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel waiting to load wheat. 4 Vessels due by 7/4, all to load wheat. Port Adelaide - Four vessels due by 4/4 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 barley. Thevenard - One vessel loading wheat. 1 Vessel due 20/3 to load wheat.
Port Lincoln - Two vessels loading wheat. 5 Vessels due by 10/4 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 lupins, 1 wheat.
BARLEY - Wallaroo - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load barley. 2 Vessels due by 21/3 of which 1 to load barley, 1 wheat.
Ardrossan - No vessels due. Port Giles - One vessel loading barley. 6 Vessels due by 28/3 of which 2 to load barley, 4 wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Two vessels loading wheat, 3 waiting to load wheat, 10 due by 10/4 of which 5 to load wheat, 3 lupins, 1 feed, 1 barley.
Kwinana - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting to load of which 1 lupins, 1 wheat. 19 Vessels due by 13/4 of which 17 to load wheat, 1 barley, 1 lupins.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat. 9 Vessels due by 8/4 of which 3 barley, 6 wheat.
Esperance - One vessel loading lupins, 3 due by 27/3 of which 2 wheat, 1 barley.
